about: The Brilliant drill's solved explanation, the long card (the Opera Game's 16.Qb8+ with a ten-line explanation at 375): folded it shows whole lines only and the 'more' chip covers none of them; one tap shows every line inside the message and the screen; a second tap folds it again; the board does not move. Graded by gate 118's TC-R338 lines (#553 B3), which exist because at kunal761 the short Opera explanation FITS its 80px box, so TC-R197g's fold lines are NOT RUN on his phone. NOT COVERED: his phone check; the hint naming piece and square (gate 133, TC-R209d); the 17px overflow of the drill header at 320x568 (another job).

breaks.name: the-more-chip-sits-over-the-text
breaks.why: the fold keeps its whole-line window but drops the 80px clear on the right, so the last shown line runs under the 'more' chip (the job's x 301-363 over line 1)

breaks.name: the-fold-shows-half-a-line
breaks.why: the folded window is half a line taller than its whole lines, so a cut line shows at the box foot (the job's 6px strip)

breaks.name: more-scrolls-the-text-instead-of-opening-it
breaks.why: 'more' scrolls the text 20px against a 21.75px pitch, as on t164, instead of opening the whole explanation
